name: stance-list
title: Stance List
description: Who holds which position on a question. Each row names a holder (a person, a group, a school of thought), labels their position with a toned badge, and says it in a sentence or two, optionally with a source.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>
docs:
## @interlace/stance-list

Installed to `components/ui/patterns/stance-list.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/patterns/stance-list';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/stance-list

Requires the `@interlace/interlace-base` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency). For the Interlace look, also add `@interlace/theme`.
